description: This is a modular spiral staircase, designed for efficient use of space. It features wooden treads that curve upwards around a central support structure. The treads are supported by a white frame and appear to be attached to a central pole. The overall design suggests a modern and compact solution for multi-level access, possibly for lofts, mezzanines, or tight spaces. The staircase is shown in an upright position, implying it's a standalone unit or part of a larger architectural model. The repetition of the treads and the clear structural elements create a visually rhythmic pattern.
